page.layout: One page of text, single column. Title block centred at top: running title, subtitle and salutation as headings. Body text in one column with a large woodcut-style initial D. Below the text: page number line with asterisk and a catchword-like signature mark at foot right.
page.notes: The initial D is a large woodcut letter joined to "octorum", printed as "Doctorum". The first line of the body is printed "Doctorum, Candide Lector, Virorum"; the word "fluxili" is as printed. The line "putredini deferre" and "miseriarum" are partly cut at the left edge of the scan; the initial letters of several lines (riarum, quam, dia, tatique, que, uere, vionisque, putredini, corrodenda, piaculumque, putamus) are clipped by the scan edge and read from context only where clearly visible. Sign-mark "* 3" and "ó βi" with a spiral ornament appear at the foot.
